pageSpec.geometryRule: Normalized geometry is durable authority. Figma pixel values are approximate. Preserve relational rhythm, photo hierarchy, asymmetry and Reference Delta before exact coordinates.

visualAuthority.firstImpression: A playful Japanese travel-magazine story page: giant blue/pink OUR STORY title on the upper-left, one dominant resort couple photo on the upper-right, a hand-drawn 1-to-5 relationship timeline descending the left half, and two torn-notebook Q&A cards stacked on the right.
visualAuthority.signatureMove: The page turns a chronological relationship story into an editorial travel route without using a rigid timeline UI: heart-number badges, handwritten headings, irregular photo prints, dotted route marks, tropical icons and paper Q&A notes overlap a warm textured field.
visualAuthority.composition: Upper ~42% is a deliberate title-vs-hero split. Middle/lower left is a vertical five-step story route with four support photos staggered toward the center. Middle/lower right is reserved for Q3 and Q4 paper notes. Bottom edge closes with a Wedding Day card, church/tropical destination cluster and PAGE 03 badge.
visualAuthority.density: high but directional; the left route is busy and sequential while the Q&A paper interiors remain comparatively calm
visualAuthority.asymmetryRule: Do not balance the page into equal columns. The hero is top-right, title top-left, timeline left-heavy, Q&A right-heavy, and support photos stagger rather than align to one grid.
